notes.title: Upcoming Dart Racer updates!
notes.notes: [p]As development progresses, it became clear that some of our ideas ware not very suitable for our team size (1 human person). Some design adjustments ware required... [/p][p][/p][p]Here are planned changes for near future:[/p][p]- Faster base dart speed[/p][p]- Streamlined stats and upgrades[/p][p]- Darts will be unique models, with stat upgrades for Core, Engines and Thrusters and base Boost type.[/p][p]- Boost type can be swapped[/p][p]- Optional 3rd person view in VR, easier to deal with higher speeds[/p][p]- No more hand tracking, too slow and limits input options too much[/p][p]- Higher Galaxy Cup revisions (speed tiers) increase base speed of all darts and AI difficulty[/p][p]  [/p][p]Many of these changes are already implemented and others are work in progress.[/p][p][/p][p]There will be 3 Darts based on existing parts and at least 2 entirely new designs in next update! They will be revealed soon...[/p][p][/p][p]See you on the ledearboards![/p]

notes.title: Dart Racer update 2.6.0: Revamped Dart progression!
notes.notes:
[p]This long in the works revamps Dart progression! [/p][p][/p][p]Completing races now rewards currency that you can spend to unlock and upgrade Dart parts. This is another step towards Galaxy Cup! 
[/p][p]That update took a while to develop... Future ones will comes faster, the plan is for 2-3 updates per month. Next up are new tracks! [/p][p][/p][p]2.6.0 Changes:[/p][p]- added currency rewards for completing races[/p][p]- rebalanced dart parts[/p][p]- tweaked dart handling[/p][p]- ai dart tweaks[/p][p]- adjusted sky track f[/p][p]- polished sky map environment[/p][p]- various polish and bug fixes[/p][p][/p][p]Happy racing playtesters![/p]
